---
citation_id: fixture-financial-01
source_url: https://example.gov.uk/fixture-financial
source_title: Fixture financial requirement
retrieved_date: "2026-08-23"
---
You must show you have enough money to support yourself and pay for your
return or onward journey without working or accessing public funds while in
the UK. There is no fixed minimum amount in your bank account required; the
amount you need depends on your circumstances.
